source_caption:
I Know What You Did Last Summer became a defining teen slasher of the 1990s because it turns guilt into the real monster. The hook-handed killer is terrifying, but the tension comes from watching four friends unravel under the weight of one terrible secret they thought they had buried.

I Know What You Did Last Summer (1997), directed by Jim Gillespie, starring Jennifer Love Hewitt, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Freddie Prinze Jr. A suspenseful teen horror film about guilt, paranoia, and revenge, following a group of friends stalked one year after a deadly accident.
